On 14 June 2023, the Security Council unanimously adopted Resolution 2686 (2023), sponsored by the UAE and UK. The vote was 15 in favour. The resolution urges States and international organizations to condemn publicly violence, hate speech, and extremism motivated by discrimination, consistent with applicable international law, including freedom of expression. It encourages civil society participation and interreligious and intercultural dialogue. The Council requests monitoring and regular reporting from UN peacekeeping and special political missions under their existing mandates. It requests a public oral briefing from the Secretary-General by 14 June 2024 and swift alerts on related threats. The text does not create a censorship power. The UAE representative made a national statement as a co-sponsor, resumed the Council presidency, took the vote, and announced the outcome.
